description: Search and read the documentation for zod-rs, a Zod-inspired Rust validation library with composable schemas, derive macros, and TypeScript codegen.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.title: Search the documentation
tools.description: Full-text search across the complete zod-rs documentation. Returns the most relevant sections as markdown.

max_results.description: Maximum number of sections to return

tools.name: get_page
tools.title: Get a documentation page
tools.description: Fetch one zod-rs documentation page as markdown. Pass a site-relative path from list_pages, e.g. /getting-started/ or /primitives/string/.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.title: List documentation pages
tools.description: List all pages of the zod-rs documentation as site-relative paths usable with get_page.
